description: Author and validate Neo4j Ontology Graph Specification (ontology graph spec) documents. Use when writing or editing an ontology, defining nodes and relationships with properties, Neo4jType data types, constraints (key/unique/must_exist), labels, and endpoint cardinality, in YAML or JSON, or validating an ontology document against the live-resolved spec schema. Does NOT handle Cypher or loading an ontology into a database — use neo4j-cypher-skill. Does NOT cover generic graph data modeling advice — use neo4j-modeling-skill.
